title: 06 · Data table · Tarrow Freight
strengths: Would pass as a shipped dispatch tool: 32 px rows, tabular figures right-aligned, status as icon + word, structured filter chips ('Status is any of In transit, Delayed +1 ×'), a bulk bar with the count, '1-10 of 412 · updated 14:06'

A detail only this product would have: the lane cell (origin, a progress line with the truck marker, destination) coloured amber when late and red on exception, with '+3h' and '-40m' deltas beside the ETA
Believable data throughout: 'TRW-48213-CH', 'CHI → LAX', 'Northvale Haul', '18,420 lb', 'Oct 16 14:20'; loading, empty and error states shown at real size with data kept during the error
slop_signals: The carrier monograms ('NV', 'BL', 'CR') as black squares are the generic initials-avatar device; a real freight tool would show the SCAC code as text
The faint manifest grid drawn across the whole page background is decoration
fixes: Set carrier codes as plain mono text and drop the black squares
Remove the page-wide background grid or confine it to the sheet margins

references.what: Selected rows with a bulk row ('2 selected · Print · Create shipping labels') and status chips with a dot + word; ours matches and is denser
Filter chips as 'Type All', 'Payment status Paid' with 'Clear all', and a sort arrow in the column header
Order IDs as links, product thumbnails, status chips and 'Total 9 items'; a count above the grid as in our '1,284' pill
Two-line order cells and 'Showing 1-4 out of 4 records'; the same footer language
